# WYEA

> WYEA (WYEA LLC, Newport Beach, California) builds firm-owned document engines for specialty insurers, MGAs and program administrators. Each engine works on policy and claims workflows: it answers questions and drafts from the policies, claims files and data an insurer already keeps, automates routine steps under a reviewer's sign-off, and states nothing it cannot show in a source document.

- One isolated system per insurer, with its own database, network and sign-in. Client documents never train a model.
- Engagements start with a one-week prototype on the client's own documents at a fixed price quoted before work starts, then a fixed-price build (from $25,000) and one monthly fee (from $5,500) that covers hosting, support and every model provider cost. Multi-entity groups are quoted at a fixed price after the prototype.
- Led by two principal engineers, Anderson Whittle and Johnson Ye.
- Not held today: SOC 2, ISO 27001, third-party penetration test, client-hosted deployment, customer-managed keys, automated export and deletion.
